How to Play

Movement

  • W, A, S, D or the arrow keys move your character.
  • Space jumps.
  • Hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to orbit the camera.
  • Use the mouse wheel to zoom in or out.

Tools

Click a tool in the hotbar or press its number key to equip it. Drag tools between numbered slots, or drag them into the open Backpack to store them in slots 11 and above.

Chat

Press /, click the chat area, or use the chat button at the top-left to start chatting. Press Enter to send the message.

Game Menu

Press Esc or click the top-left menu button to resume, reset your character, change settings, or leave the game.

Developer Console

Press F9 to view local script, loader, engine, warning, and error output. Press F9 again or use the red close button to close it.

Map Controls

Some maps include their own tools, buttons, vehicles, camera controls, and scripted instructions. Those controls can differ from map to map.
